text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When a developer finishes writing a piece of code, another team member carefully checks it before it is added to the main project. This simple step helps catch bugs early, which saves time and money because fixing a problem later is much harder than preventing it at the start. Beyond finding errors, code reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Junior developers learn from seeing how seniors solve problems, while seniors also gain fresh perspectives from newer team members. Most importantly, this practice builds a shared sense of team quality, where everyone takes responsibility for the final product.
